text: This is not a dashboard. It is a mission room where agents turn signals into decisions.
Agentium starts where enterprise reality lives: connectors, documents, applications, operational feeds and secure data boundaries.
The hypervisor gives leaders a portfolio view: value, cost, ROI, confidence and decisions across systems, not isolated bots.
Every business capability becomes a system: objective, skills, knowledge, policies and runtime traces.
The Flow Builder makes the agentic system explicit. Nodes, skills, grounding, control policy and human review are no longer hidden in prompts.
This is not a diagram. It is a live runtime manifest: validated, versioned, executable and auditable.
Once executed, every run becomes observable: inputs, outputs, evaluations, traces and decisions.
At C-level, the question is not whether one agent works. It is how an AI portfolio performs against strategic objectives.
In Octocity, the same factory pattern powers OCTAVE, an executive assistant for synthetic but realistic institutional operations.
Leaders can ask in natural language, retrieve context and trigger governed actions.
Knowledge Capture closes the loop by turning field expertise into reviewed, reusable memory.
Built by Datategy, Agentium is the AI operating system for supervised, mission-critical work in 2026.
